summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 tests). Nothing is committed. black and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand: no line exceeds 88 characters. Choices beyond the spec: cyclic RDF lists and lists missing rdf:first or rdf:rest raise SHACLPathError. A self-referencing nested blank node is not detected and will recurse until Python stops it.
